info.name: ChatBot API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the ChatBot API (Django REST Framework).

## Base URL
All endpoints are under `{{base_url}}` (default `http://localhost:8000`).

## Authentication
Most endpoints accept either:
- **JWT** – `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`  (get one from `Auth > Login`)
- **API key** – `X-API-Key: <api_key>`  (or `Authorization: ApiKey <api_key>`)

The collection sends the JWT (`{{access_token}}`) by default at the collection level. For the chat / knowledge / analytics endpoints you may instead use the `{{api_key}}` variable via the `X-API-Key` header (a disabled example header is included on those requests).

The **Login** request has a test script that automatically saves `access_token` and `refresh_token` into collection variables.

## Admin-only endpoints
User management, API-key management, subscription assignment, plan writes and WhatsApp accounts require a staff/admin user.

request.description: Obtain a JWT access + refresh token pair. On success the test script stores `access_token`, `refresh_token`, and (if present) `api_key` into collection variables.
Exchange a refresh token for a new access token.
Verify that a JWT is valid (returns 200 with empty body if valid).

item.name: Users
item.description: User accounts. List/create/update/delete are admin-only. Self-service (any authenticated user, own account): me (GET/PATCH profile), change-email + verify-email (verified email change), change-password, and api-key (view only). Users cannot rotate their own API key — that is admin-only.

request.description: Admin only. Creates a user, issues an API key, and optionally assigns a plan (`plan` = slug or id, `plan_duration_days` default 30). `plan` fields are optional. If an email is given, a 6-digit verification code is emailed to it and the account starts with `email_verified: false`; the response includes `email_verification` (code_sent | not_sent | send_failed). The new user confirms via POST /users/verify-email/.
Admin only. Alias of create user (same behavior, including the email verification code + email_verified: false).

Step 1 of verified email change. Emails a 6-digit code to the new address; the email is NOT changed until you confirm with verify-email.
Step 2 of verified email change. Submit the 6-digit code from the email to apply the new address.

item.description: Admin-only control plane for API keys across all users.

item.name: Chat
item.description: Multi-tenant chat + feedback. Authenticate with API key or JWT; answers are scoped to that tenant's knowledge and chatbot config.

request.description: `history` is optional (max CHAT_MAX_HISTORY_TURNS exchanges). `language` optional; blank = auto-detect.

body.raw:
{
  "question": "What are your business hours?",
  "answer": "We are open 9am-5pm.",
  "source": "rag",
  "source_id": "",
  "rating": "up",
  "comment": "Helpful answer"
}

request.description: Record feedback on a chat answer. `source` is `rag`; `rating` is `up` or `down`.
Get the authenticated tenant's chatbot configuration (auto-created on first access).

body.raw:
{
  "assistant_name": "Aida",
  "company_name": "Acme Inc.",
  "default_language": "en",
  "tone": "friendly",
  "strict_grounding": true,
  "no_answer_message": "Sorry, I don't have that information.",
  "top_k": 5,
  "similarity_threshold": 0.75
}

item.name: Documents
item.description: Upload and manage knowledge documents (scoped to the authenticated tenant).

request.description: Upload a file; it is chunked and embedded on ingestion. Select a file for the `file` field.
Writable fields: file, is_active.
Force re-chunking and re-embedding of an existing document.
Upload a Word (.docx) file; parsed, chunked and embedded immediately.
Fetch items from an external public API and ingest them into the RAG system. Only `api_url` is required. `document_name` default 'API Content', `items_key` default 'results'.
The authenticated tenant's usage rollup + live quota consumption.

query.description: Admin only: per-tenant summary across all tenants

item.name: Unanswered Questions
item.description: Knowledge gaps captured when the bot answered with low confidence (AI-filtered + de-duplicated). Scoped to the authenticated tenant; no create endpoint (rows come from the chat pipeline).

request.description: Only `status` is writable (new | reviewed | answered | dismissed).
With an `answer`, it is embedded into the tenant's knowledge (retrievable by the bot next time) and the gap is marked answered. Send an empty body to just mark it answered without adding knowledge.

item.name: Plans
item.description: Browse plans (any authenticated user); create/update/delete are admin-only.

request.description: `slug` optional (auto-derived from name).
Assign (or move) a user to a plan for a billing period.
The caller's own subscription + live usage for the current period (any authenticated user).

item.name: WhatsApp
item.description: WhatsApp integration. The webhook is public (Meta Cloud API); everything else requires auth. Accounts are admin-only.

request.description: Meta webhook verification handshake. Returns the challenge string when the verify token matches.
Incoming message / status update from the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (public endpoint).
Send a free-form text message to a WhatsApp user.
Link a tenant to a WhatsApp Business number. `access_token` is write-only.
